note: Both sets correctly capture the LIGHTING LEVELS table (3 FC / 5-10 FC / 30 FC / 50 FC with their bulb counts and activity conditions) plus the T24 high-efficacy requirement and the own-switch requirement for kitchen, bathroom, closet and laundry rooms. Set A additionally extracts the 40W incandescent / 9W compact-fluorescent light-output comparison, but it misses the vacancy-sensor bypass requirement and repeats many table claims verbatim, including one vague claim whose value is just 'same'. Set B is less redundant, adds the vacancy-sensor/dimming-bypass requirement with its condition, and has no misbound or invented claims, though it omits the bulb-equivalence example and the 7W LED fact (also missed by A).
